dct_description_sm: Yukon Government's (YG) climate change adaptation efforts began formally in 2009 with the inception of the Yukon Government Climate Change Action Plan and a clear articulation of adaptation as a key government priority. With the addition of Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada (AANDC), Northern Strategy Trust Fund, and other partnerships, YG was able to mobilize key adaptation projects across the territory. The overall intent was that effective climate change adaptation projects become mainstream activity for YG departments and the communities they affect thereby offering effective climate change adaptation approaches to all Yukoners. The Yukon Government chose several of Yukon's best proposals for adaptation projects and put them forth when applying for AANDC funding. This particular project has built on previous research in the Teslin area and addressed issues of forest-related vulnerabilities to climate change through a community-based participatory approach.
